← Reading Habit Coach

Every book has a place.

A private bookshelf for the books you are reading, saving for later and remembering.

Can I track physical books and audiobooks together?

Yes. Each record has its own format. Choose Want to Read, Reading, Finished, Paused or Abandoned, then filter your library.

A library you can search

Search title, author, ISBN, genre or tags. Metadata lookup is optional. You can always enter details yourself. Book tiles are typographic representations, not publisher cover artwork.
